correctness.rationale: The triangular determinant-one map gives exactly the 2-by-m order polytope; Stanley chamber triangulation yields independent uniform Catalan word and uniform order statistics. Rank identities recover Dyck heights at step 2j. Independent exponential spacings and concentration give the uniform-process Gaussian/Brownian scaling without changing the canonical Euclidean metric. Beta moments plus uniform Dyck maximum moments justify all positive moment limits. The 3-bridge KL product gives the Laplace law, mean one and variance four fifteenths. Standalone finite convex-hull, exact enumeration, and sample checks passed; finite experiments are not substitutes for the invariance principle.

value.rationale: Canonical Euclidean face distance under uniform interior volume is a natural bulk geometric invariant, unlike a table lookup of vertex counts. The coordinates collapse individually at \(m^{-1/2}\) but Euclidean distance does not collapse, and the exact non-Gaussian limit and all moments quantify that difference. The full continuous profile gives a stronger structural geometric limit useful for other observables, such as maximal column deviation.
